tests.name: Signup
tests.assertion: A brand-new KSTEST user signs up through the real signup UI of the staging app; lands logged in; the session survives force-stop + relaunch

tests.name: Logout / login
tests.assertion: Log out, log in again with the same mobile number (phone login); an unregistered and a malformed number are refused with the in-app message
tests.notes: unregistered → "इस नंबर से कोई खाता नहीं मिला। कृपया नया खाता बनाएं।"; malformed → "कृपया सही 10 अंकों का मोबाइल नंबर भरें।"; phone login is trust-based (no OTP), lands on /home

tests.name: Post with photo
tests.assertion: As the KSTEST user, post a listing (marker KSTEST…) with a photo; it appears in My Listings and Browse; the detail page shows the photo (naturalWidth > 0) and the photo URL returns 200 from staging storage

tests.name: Contact reveal
tests.assertion: A second KSTEST user reveals the number on user A's listing; logged out, the reveal goes to login with the return path and comes back after login

tests.name: Profile and My Listings
tests.assertion: Both render for the logged-in user; an edited profile field persists after relaunch (pincode behaviour recorded)
tests.notes: KNOWN ISSUE confirmed: saving needs a pincode (first save: "कृपया सही 6 अंकों का पिन कोड भरें।"); saved after entering 470001

tests.name: Post page location fallback
tests.assertion: Logged in, /post step 3, "use my current location": GPS on → coordinates near the emulator position (which step: cached ≤ 10 min / fresh ≤ 20 s recorded); GPS off → within ~25 s the clear fallback message and the cursor in the village field, no crash
tests.notes: GPS on → fresh; GPS off → fallback after 21060 ms

tests.name: Keyboard never hides a field
tests.assertion: For /login, /signup, /search, the feedback form (/grievance), Profile edit and every /post step: the LOWEST text field, tapped with a real on-screen keyboard drawn, is fully visible above the keyboard (a), its submit/next button scrolls into view with the keyboard up (b), and after closing the keyboard nothing stays covered (c). Forms needing an account are NOT-RUN where no login is allowed (prod)
tests.notes: FAILED: post step 2 (details): the on-screen keyboard came up (dumpsys: input shown + visible IME frame) ({"shown":true,"top":null,"frame":null,"imeShowing":false}) | 7 forms measured

tests.name: Cache fills online
tests.assertion: Visiting /, /mausam (Sagar), /msp, /browse and a listing detail online stores an IndexedDB entry for each, with a recent cachedAt

tests.name: Offline with cache
tests.assertion: Airplane mode, force-stop, cold launch: /, /mausam, /msp, /browse and the listing detail show the SAME data as online, with the stamp = stored time; no ErrorBoundary; banner does not cover the header

tests.name: Offline without cache
tests.assertion: Cache cleared, offline, a freshly chosen place: /mausam and /msp show a clear offline message with a working "try again" within 10–12 s; no spinner remains

tests.name: Home shows one "last updated" time offline
tests.assertion: Online visit fills the cache; airplane mode + cold launch: Home shows the offline banner with its time and NO second stamp under the ticker (exactly one timestamp). Online-but-saved-data (banner gone, data still from the phone): the stamp is shown

tests.name: /cold-storage failed load (app)
tests.assertion: Cache emptied, airplane mode, cold launch: /cold-storage shows the "could not load" notice with "try again" (no ErrorBoundary, no uncaught error, no spinner left); back online, "try again" loads the list
tests.notes: notice after 1644 ms; 17 cache entries cleared first

tests.name: Edge-to-edge / safe areas
tests.assertion: API 36 portrait: NavBar below the status bar, tab bar buttons above the navigation bar and not covered, offline banner below the status bar, last footer link fully visible above the tab bar
tests.notes: window padded by Capacitor (CSS insets 0); status bar bottom 136px, navigation bar top 2337px, dpr 2.625; the edge-to-edge CSS path was also checked with simulated insets

tests.name: Offline
tests.assertion: Airplane mode + cold launch: app shell renders (not a browser error page), offline banner visible, no crash; /, /browse, /mausam, /msp, /about show content or an in-app failure state; back online the banner goes within 15 s and /mausam loads data
tests.notes: offline via cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable. What each page shows offline (input for batch 8B) — /: 4561 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 16, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0 || /browse: 1589 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 0, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0 || /mausam: 3186 chars; temperatures 31, ₹ values 0, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0 || /msp: 2530 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 10, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 1 || /about: 2628 chars; temperatures 0, ₹ values 0, listings 0, ticker still loading false, spinners 0

tests.name: Keyboard + search
tests.assertion: On /search a real tap brings up a DRAWN on-screen keyboard (IME frame visible + screenshot differs), the focused input is fully visible above the keyboard and not covered, and a query known to have results renders results
tests.notes: query "wheat" → 16 results; keyboard top 1517px, input bottom 495px
